senses.gloss: f. pl. (βασίλικα, sub. κάρυα, basilicæ, sub. nuces) basilicæ, the best kind of nuts.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:9">Tosef. Dem. I, 9</cite> [read:] <he>האגוזין ודורמסקיות ופ׳</he> (Var. <he>והפסדקאות</he>; <he>ופסליא</he> ed. Zuck., Var. <he>ופסיליה</he>, standing for βασιλεια, a dittography of our w.) nuts, plums, and walnuts.
